question: Which world champion pole-vaulter cleared 6.28 m, setting a new world record at the Stockholm Diamond League?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mondo Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Armand "Mondo" Duplantis** is a Swedish-American pole vaulter who holds the current **world record** in both indoor and outdoor events. He represents **Sweden** in international competitions.
 
• Duplantis has a remarkable history at the **Stockholm Diamond League** (Bauhaus-Galan), where he has repeatedly broken records and set world-leading marks in front of his home crowd.
 
• He is widely considered the greatest pole vaulter of the modern era, having secured **Olympic Gold Medals** at the **2020 Tokyo Games** and the **2024 Paris Games**.
 
• The **Diamond League** is an annual series of elite track and field athletic competitions, and Duplantis has used these stages to systematically increase the world record, often by **1 centimeter** at a time to maximize performance bonuses and career longevity.
